runs.title: Great Wolf Lodge: what happened, and what do police say?
runs.prompt: Police are investigating a double homicide at the Great Wolf Lodge indoor water park in Monroe County, Pennsylvania, reported today 13 October 2026. Find the facts as they are publicly known: where exactly it happened (town and resort), what police or the coroner have said, and whether there is any official statement or contact line for information. runs.answer: Facts as publicly reported (as of Oct 13, 2026): The incident occurred at the Great Wolf Lodge in the Pocono Mountains, 1 Great Wolf Drive, Scotrun, Monroe County, PA — in Pocono Township. The Monroe County Coroner's Office confirmed it is investigating a double homicide, described by police as a domestic incident that happened Monday evening (Oct 12, 2026) in a guest room; the two people killed were a 3-year-old boy and his father. Pocono Township Police say 27-year-old Metallica Harrison of Towanda, who made the 911 call, was taken into custody and charged with two counts of criminal homicide, pending a preliminary hearing (per WFMZ). Great Wolf Lodge issued an official statement calling it "a tragic domestic incident…an isolated family incident," saying it is "cooperating fully with local law enforcement," and asking that "any further information regarding this matter be directed to Pocono Township Police Department." The resort says operations continue, with a small restricted-access area, and is offering no-change-fee postponements to uneasy guests. Official contact for information: Pocono Township Police Department, 110 Township Drive, Tannersville, PA 18372, phone (570) 629-

runs.title: Edge Early Learning: which 11 centres are closing?
runs.prompt: Eleven Edge Early Learning childcare centres in Australia are closing after the operator failed to find buyers, reported 13 October 2026. Find which centres are closing, in which states and towns, when they close, and what families are being told to do. Start at 7news.com.au and the ABC News article on the closures.
runs.answer: Eleven Edge Early Learning centres are closing after administrators KordaMentha (appointed when the group entered voluntary administration in August 2026) secured buyers for 53 other centres but found no viable offer for these 11. The Queensland closures (7) are: Cannon Hill, Kelvin Grove, Milton, Morayfield East, South Brisbane, Strathpine – Railway Avenue, and West End – Jane St. South Australia has 3: Oaklands Park, Plympton and Royal Park. The ACT has 1: Ngunnawal. They close effective close of business Wednesday 14 October 2026 — parents got only about 48 hours' notice (letters sent Monday 13 October; some families only learned on Tuesday morning when dropping off children). Staff may return Thursday 15 October to collect belongings, with no care provided that day. Families are being advised in writing of nearby facilities with some availability for new enrolments and are encouraged to contact them directly to arrange alternative care; anyone who paid fees in advance will be refunded by the end of October (7NEWS notes it may be later given the volume of refunds).

runs.title: Stunt: pry retatrutide numbers from NEJM
runs.prompt: The New England Journal of Medicine has published the study behind today's big Eli Lilly retatrutide announcement (article DOI: 10.1056/NEJMoa2604169). Go to the article page and extract the key numbers from the abstract: average weight loss, A1C reduction, and any safety findings. Report exactly what the page allows you to see, and if you hit a paywall or bot wall, say so plainly and quote whatever text is visible.
runs.answer: The live NEJM article page (https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2604169 and the /abs/ variant) is behind a Cloudflare bot wall — the only visible text is "Just a moment...". I retrieved the full abstract instead from NCBI/PubMed E-utilities (PMID 42814954). Key numbers from the abstract (TRIUMPH-1, phase 3, 2339 adults with obesity, 80 weeks): mean change in body weight was −17.6% (retatrutide 4 mg), −23.7% (9 mg) and −25.0% (12 mg) vs −3.9% with placebo (differences −19.8 and −21.0 percentage points; P<0.001). Safety: "The most common adverse events were gastrointestinal." Notably, NO A1C data are reported because this trial enrolled adults with obesity WITHOUT diabetes (it also reported secondary outcomes: WOMAC knee-osteoarthritis pain score and apnea-hypopnea index improvements).
obstacles: NEJM page returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' bot wall on both full and abs URLs
Europe PMC also returned the same 403 bot wall
PubMed HTML page required cookies; worked around via the eutils efetch API
